San Antonio Wheelmen Weekend Rides

San Antonio, TX · Road

San Antonio Wheelmen Weekend Rides is a road group ride in San Antonio, TX. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 7:30 am. Pace: multiple routes by pace; no-drop only where the calendar says so.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: multiple routes by pace; no-drop only where the calendar says so. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @earnabikesa the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the San Antonio Wheelmen Weekend Rides group ride

Club road rides from rotating starts around San Antonio, like Woman Hollering Creek, Bulverde and Cibolo. Each ride has routes sorted by terrain and expected speed. Arrive 15 minutes early to sign the release and get a map. Helmets required. Riders under 18 need an adult. There is also a Sunday recovery ride.
